name: repokeel
description: Reusable development knowledge and exceptional context recovery

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve relevant knowledge, learn conditionally, recover only after interruption.
interface.longDescription: Retrieve once at real task start, execute under project authority, and write knowledge only when new or outdated after acceptance. Existing recovery readers remain available for actual context loss or handoff; no routine work-unit lifecycle is required.
